name: Image consultant and personal stylist

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Style session
services.story: The main story: a $55 style session by video, paid in full when booking.

services.name: Follow-up session
services.story: A $35 follow-up session: a card is saved for the $20 late-cancel fee, and the $35 is charged when the stylist texts DONE.

services.name: Wardrobe edit
services.story: A $90 wardrobe edit, priced from the client's closet photos: a $20 deposit now, and the $70 rest on the saved card at DONE.

services.name: Quick outfit review
services.story: A $25 quick outfit review: nothing is taken, and the client pays at the front desk.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: Home style session
services.story: The main story: a $179 home session; a card is saved for the $89 visit fee and the $179 is charged when the stylist texts DONE.

services.name: Wardrobe edit at your home
services.story: A $640 wardrobe edit at the client's home, priced from closet photos: a $160 deposit now, and the $480 rest on the bill after.

services.name: Team style workshop
services.story: A $179 team style workshop at a company's office: nothing is taken, and the bill is texted after.

services.name: Closet check at home
services.story: A $150 closet check at the client's home, paid in full when booking; a late cancel may keep the $89 visit fee.

services_shape: Image consulting and personal styling: style sessions by video, by phone or at the studio (flow A), and at a client's home or a company's office (flow B). Every new client starts with a free intro call. Clothes and products are bought by the client from the stores; Rosie never takes money for goods.
questions_before_times: What do you want: a new look, a wardrobe edit, colors, or a look for work or an event?
Roughly when, and how many people?
At the studio, by video or phone, or at your home?
safety_stop: someone in danger or hurt right now, at home or in the studio
license: No license is needed for this work in most places. A registration or certificate the state asks for is the business's own to add. It is optional, and nothing is looked up.
messages_never: Body measurements, sizes, health or skin concerns, the clothes or budget a client shares, and when a home will be empty.
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
